comment.narrative: As of 2017 Public administration excessively large with unsatisfactory credentials merit training and credentials underpaid in many cases politicised and discriminatory

The adoption and the entry in force of the new Law on Public Officials 06L114 provides for a meritbased process of recruitment in civil service ensuring a less politicised and more transparent process of employment of YCS scholarship recipients in PA. The correct implementation of this new legal framework is of paramount importance to improve professionalism and accountability in civil service. Public administration is still very large and underpaid in many cases even if the YCS contributed to make it more accountable and inclusive.
